physics-killer-09.title: Seerota sochii Newton fi tiyoorii wal-qabatiinsa addaa
physics-killer-09.topic: Seerota sochii Newton fi tiyoorii wal-qabatiinsa addaa
physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-09.material: Hojii makaa walitti makuu (fusion) $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ keessatti massiin partikila tokkoon tokkoon isaanii $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, niwutiroonii: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$ dha. Angaa $1\,\mathrm{u}$ wajjin wal-qixa $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ godhaa, angaan sochii partikila hojii dura dagadhaa. Hojii kana keessatti angaa baafame $E$ fi baay'inni sochii $\mathrm{^4He}$ fi niwutiroonii uumaman wal-qixa ta'ee, madaallii massii $4:1$ yoo jedhame, angaa sochii niwutiroonii qabu hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Seerota sochii Newton fi tiyoorii wal-qabatiinsa addaa
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Hojii makaa walitti makuu (fusion) $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$ keessatti massiin partikila tokkoon tokkoon isaanii $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, niwutiroonii: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$ dha. Angaa $1\,\mathrm{u}$ wajjin wal-qixa $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$ godhaa, angaan sochii partikila hojii dura dagadhaa. Hojii kana keessatti angaa baafame $E$ fi baay'inni sochii $\mathrm{^4He}$ fi niwutiroonii uumaman wal-qixa ta'ee, madaallii massii $4:1$ yoo jedhame, angaa sochii niwutiroonii qabu hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$ waan ta'eef $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Hojii booda partikila lamaan baay'inni sochii wal-qixa waan ta'eef $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ fi $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Kanaaf $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Madaallii massii faallaan yoo garagalchan $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ②), angaa yoo walakkaan qooddan deebii dogoggoraa ③, $\Delta m$ $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ yoo dogoggoraan herregan deebii dogoggoraa ④ ta'a.
